**mpv** is a free, cross-platform media player, running natively on your jailbroken device on the iosc Wayland compositor.

This is a real native arm64 binary cross-compiled for rootless iOS. It plays video and audio through its bundled FFmpeg libraries and uses the device hardware where it counts.

- VideoToolbox hardware video decode on Apple silicon
- Real audio output through the CoreAudio and PulseAudio path
- Native Wayland output on the iosc compositor
- Wide format support via FFmpeg and libass subtitles

Built for iPadOS/iOS rootless (palera1n/Dopamine, `/var/jb`). Launch it inside an Xios desktop session running the iosc compositor.

## 0.36.0  ·  2026-07-02
